# LTP testcases/kernel/syscalls directories run inside Coal (one per line; # comments).
# Files and descriptors
access chdir chmod chown close creat dup dup2 dup3 fchdir fchmod fcntl fdatasync fstat fstatfs fsync ftruncate
getcwd getdents link lseek lstat mkdir mkdirat mknod open openat pipe pipe2 pread preadv pwrite pwritev read
readlink readv rename rmdir stat statfs symlink truncate umask unlink unlinkat utime utimes write writev
# Processes, ids, limits
fork vfork wait waitpid wait4 exit exit_group getpid getppid getpgid getpgrp setpgid setsid getsid kill pause
getuid geteuid getgid getegid setuid setgid getrlimit setrlimit getrusage getpriority setpriority nice uname
sysinfo gettid tgkill tkill sched_yield getcpu prctl arch_prctl
# Memory
brk sbrk mmap mprotect munmap madvise mremap msync mlock munlock
# Signals
rt_sigaction rt_sigprocmask sigaction sigprocmask sigpending sigsuspend sigaltstack signal
# Time
nanosleep clock_gettime clock_getres clock_nanosleep gettimeofday time times alarm getitimer setitimer
# Waiting and sockets
select pselect poll ppoll socket socketpair bind listen connect accept accept4 send sendto recv recvfrom
recvmsg sendmsg shutdown getsockname getpeername getsockopt setsockopt getrandom
